    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0.75), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
    .cylinder(1.5, 14.0)

            .extrude(-3.8, taper=10.0)
    )

            .rect(1.8, 1.8)
            .extrude(-3.8, taper=10.0)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(-9.75, 0.0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .rect(1.8, 1.8)
            .extrude(-3.8, taper=10.0)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
